# Lavendar Lewis

## Overview

- **Age:** presumed 45  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P34](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0034), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P54](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0054), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P10](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0010)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P45](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0045)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Irving](../character/irving.md) (spouse), [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) (spouse)

## Appearance

Lavendar Lewis is a little lady with thick, beautifully wavy snow-white hair that is carefully arranged in becoming puffs and coils. She has a girlish, pink-cheeked face featuring dimples, sweet lips, pretty cheeks, and big, soft brown eyes. Additionally, she has pretty hands.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P45](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0045), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P25](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0025), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P34](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0034), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P58](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0058), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P29](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0029)_

## Personality

Lavendar Lewis possesses a deeply imaginative nature. She relies heavily on pretending and imagination to cope with the difficulties of life.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P57](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0057)_

- imaginative  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P57](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0057)</sub>

## History

Named by her father after his favorite scent, Miss Lavendar Lewis suffered a broken heart when a youthful romantic quarrel led her former fiancé, [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), to leave her. Years later, living at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) with her young helper [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), she invited lost visitors [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) to an imaginary tea party, where she inquired about Stephen's son after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) inadvertently mentioned him. Following a visit where she shared the story of her past romance with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), Miss Lavendar was introduced to Stephen's son, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), and formed an immediate, fond friendship with him. After experiencing a period of despondency, she received a note from the returning [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) via [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and reconciled with him during an evening visit at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). The two were subsequently married in an intimate ceremony in her garden before departing together.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P53](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0053), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P62](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0062), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P71](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0071), +23 more_

## Background by volume

**Volume 2**

- formerly engaged to Stephen Irving when they were young  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P36](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0036)</sub>
- hired little Charlotta Bowman for board and clothes after her mother died ten years earlier  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- presumed jilted by Stephen Irving according to local gossip  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045)</sub>
- named Lavendar by her father because he loved the scent  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P86](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0086)</sub>
- suffered a broken heart when Stephen Irving did not return after their quarrel  <sub>[v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019)</sub>

## Quotes

> "But oh, won’t you stay and have tea with me? Please, do. Mr. Kimball’s will have tea over before you get there. And Charlotta the Fourth and I will be so glad to have you."
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049)

> "to believe I’m old. Now, who are you . . . just for convenience’ sake? Diana Barry? And Anne Shirley? May I pretend that I’ve known you for a hundred years and call you Anne and Diana right away?"
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P62](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0062)

> "I love them myself. They are very good company . . . with a little pretending. On calm evenings Charlotta the Fourth and I often sit out here and amuse ourselves with them. Charlotta, take back the horn and hang it carefully in its place."
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P74](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0074)

> "It gave me a shock to hear about Stephen’s son that first day you were here, Anne. I’ve never been able to mention him to you since, but I’ve wanted to know all about him. What sort of a boy is he?"
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P21](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0021)

> "Oh, I’m not so old as I thought . . . and I don’t need a single blue pill! Girls, when you come back with your strawberries we’ll have tea out here under the silver poplar. I’ll have it all ready for you with home-grown cream."
>
> — Lavendar Lewis — [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P36](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0036)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--lavendar-lewis.md)

Miss Lavendar and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) become close friends after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stumbles upon [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) while lost in the woods. Miss Lavendar welcomes her for tea, confides in her about her past romance, and enjoys her frequent visits. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) acts as a comforting presence, introducing her to [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) and later helping her prepare for [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) Irving's return and her wedding.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), +13 more_

- Friend of — close friends who visit each other  <sub>[v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P31](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0031), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P34](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0034), +1 more</sub>

### [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlotta--lavendar-lewis.md)

[Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md) serves as Miss Lavendar's young maid and helper at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). Beyond her domestic duties, [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) demonstrates deep affection and concern for her mistress, noticing when Miss Lavendar is despondent and helping her prepare for major events, including her reunion with [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) and her wedding.

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana-barry--lavendar-lewis.md)

### [Irving](../character/irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/irving--lavendar-lewis.md)
